I've hit my tool call budget, but I have enough data to provide the analysis. Let me compile the findings:

## US MARCH 2026 OPERATING EXPENSE FLUX vs FEBRUARY

**ACCOUNTS EXCEEDING THRESHOLD (>10% AND >$5,000):**

---

### 1. **HOSTING & INFRASTRUCTURE (5000): +$9,646.40 (30.8%)**
**Feb $31,301.80 → Mar $40,948.20**

| Transaction | Date | Description | Amount | Support |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| JE-00125 | Feb 3 | Stackline Cloud production infrastructure | $31,301.80 | ✓ |
| JE-00232 | Mar 3 | Stackline Cloud production infrastructure | $31,148.20 | ✓ |
| JE-00258 | Mar 14 | **Stackline Cloud one-time data migration** | **$9,800.00** | ✓ |

**Analysis:** The flux is driven by a one-time data migration charge ($9,800) that occurred in March. The recurring monthly infrastructure cost was actually *lower* in March ($31,148 vs $31,302). **HOLDS UP** ✓

---

### 2. **TRAVEL (6300): +$6,373.01 (811.0%)**
**Feb $785.40 → Mar $7,158.41**

| Transaction | Date | Description | Amount | Support |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Regular cards (Feb) | Various | Uber, Delta, Hilton | $785.40 | ✓ |
| Regular cards (Mar) | Various | Uber, Delta, Hilton | $858.41 | ✓ |
| **JE-00300** | **Mar 29** | **Travel reimbursement - T. Vance** | **$6,300.00** | **✗ NO** |

**Analysis:** 88% of the March increase ($6,300 of $6,373) is driven by a single entry: JE-00300, a travel reimbursement to T. Vance. **THIS ENTRY LACKS SUPPORTING DOCUMENTATION.** **DOES NOT HOLD UP** ✗

---

### 3. **MARKETING PROGRAMS (6400): +$21,787.86 (275.8%)**
**Feb $7,898.14 → Mar $29,686.00**

| Transaction | Date | Description | Amount | Support |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| JE-00241 | Mar 6 | Meridian Events – SaaS Connect Spring sponsorship (event 3/17-3/19) | $22,000.00 | ✓ |
| JE-00243 | Mar 6 | Oakridge Creative – Content and campaign services | $7,686.00 | ✓ |

**Analysis:** Both entries are properly supported AP invoices. This represents a planned marketing event sponsorship ($22k) plus concurrent campaign services ($7.7k). **HOLDS UP** ✓

---

## **SUMMARY**

| Account | Change | Driver(s) | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hosting | +$9.6K | One-time data migration | ✓ Supported |
| Travel | +$6.4K | **Unsupported T. Vance reimbursement ($6.3K)** | **✗ FAILS** |
| Marketing | +$21.8K | Event sponsorship + campaign services | ✓ Supported |

**⚠️ ACTION REQUIRED:** JE-00300 (Travel reimbursement - T. Vance, $6,300) must be investigated. It is posted without support documentation and represents the core driver of the 811% travel expense increase.
